## File: facebookresearch_nerf-det/mmdet3d/ops/iou3d/iou3d_utils.py

Prompts

```
['build a python module to calculate IoU between two sets of 3D bounding boxes in bird eye view', 'create a function that runs GPU NMS on detection boxes with optional pre and post max size limits', 'run normal non maximum suppression on GPU for 3D detection boxes and scores with a threshold', 'refactor the nms_gpu function to support a dynamic IoU threshold for 3D box suppression', 'review the boxes_iou_bev function and its CUDA kernel usage for 3D box overlap calculation']
```

Usage

```
{'build_bev_iou_calculation': 'build a python module to calculate IoU between two sets of 3D bounding boxes in bird eye view', 'create_nms_with_pre_post_limits': 'create a function that runs GPU NMS on detection boxes with optional pre and post max size limits', 'run_normal_gpu_nms': 'run normal non maximum suppression on GPU for 3D detection boxes and scores with a threshold', 'refactor_nms_gpu_threshold': 'refactor the nms_gpu function to support a dynamic IoU threshold for 3D box suppression', 'review_boxes_iou_bev': 'review the boxes_iou_bev function and its CUDA kernel usage for 3D box overlap calculation'}
```
